# Base font command registrations

The frozen MathJax 3.2.2 `BaseMappings` macros table registers 43 argument-taking
`MathFont` commands and 11 `SetFont` declarations. The Go dispatcher previously
recognized 15 of these 54 registrations. It now derives both dispatch maps from
the retained source table, restoring the other 39 spellings, including the `sym`
aliases, bold script/fraktur/sans-serif combinations, and `mit`/`oldstyle`.
The pre-existing Go-only `boldsymbol` extension remains separately registered.

`MathFont` with an empty variant (`mathnormal` and `symnormal`) also exercises
`ParseMethods.mathchar7`'s truthiness check: an empty environment font must retain
the mapped default of a command such as `Gamma`, even inside an outer font scope.
Other mapped symbol classes keep their existing behavior.

The fixture contains 1,072 complete, unmodified SVGs from D2's original MathJax
bundle at source commit `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`. Every source
font command is exercised in six contexts, in display and inline mode. Another
120 cases cover empty variants inside five outer fonts, Greek capital commands,
literal characters, nested declarations, macros, scripts, and accents.
The remaining 304 cases override every font command through declared operators
and paired delimiters, including nested and positioned declaration uses. User
registrations must take precedence over lexical SetFont processing; the same
rule applies to both newly restored and previously supported declarations.

An independent review compared 820 additional original expressions, all exact
after correcting this registration precedence, with no regressions. The full
frozen-oracle suite, race tests, vet, and WebAssembly build also pass.

Regenerate with:

```
node --jitless testdata/generate_font_mappings.cjs /path/to/pinned-d2-assets
```

The generator verifies all three original asset hashes and creates a fresh
original runtime for each expression. No expected SVG is generated by Go.
